stages.title: Scope & safety gate
stages.purpose: Check track alignment, required human_only steps, and safe-topic rules before drafting.

stages.title: Volunteer agent draft & deterministic checks
stages.purpose: One volunteer agent builds the kit, fixtures, skill, and MCP tool spec; verifier runs.

stages.title: Independent review & CAS catalog publish
stages.purpose: A different agent or human steward (drafter != reviewer) audits and publishes to eranos.catalog.

requests.title: Disaster charity registry & rental deposit escrow check kit
constraints: Synthetic fixtures only, each marked SYNTHETIC
Keep individual_decision and external_send marked human_only
Never label an unregistered mutual-aid group with accusatory terms

requests.title: Field volunteer shift onboarding & incident escalation SOP kit
constraints: Synthetic fixtures only, each marked SYNTHETIC
Keep crisis_safety_plan and individual_decision marked human_only

requests.title: Executable reference runner for MCPToolSpec deterministic checks
constraints: Validate every fixture input against MCPToolSpec.input_schema without network calls
Keep eranos/ free of hardcoded track IDs
requests.done_when: verifier validates fixture inputs against input_schema and `make check` passes

requests.title: Export published kits as downloadable SKILL.md + MCP tool bundles
constraints: Include SYNTHETIC notice, human_only boundary table, and SHA-256 receipt in every exported bundle
requests.done_when: `uv run eranos export-bundle KIT-RECRUIT-01` writes SKILL.md, tool.json, and checklist.md tested in pytest
